Hi Amina,

Great to meet you on Friday — excited to get Halcyon’s data into the sandbox next week. Per our call we spun up a 30‑day PLG sandbox (standard), 250k token allotment, and a shared workspace so your ML team can run model-fit experiments. I attached the SOW draft and a short usage snapshot from the onboarding tests.

Two quick asks before kickoff:
- Can you confirm the two model variants you want enabled (gpt-redwood-13b and rw-embed-2)?
- Will procurement require a PO or simply a signed SOW to start billing after the sandbox period?

If you anticipate needing more runtime or an extended runway beyond the 30 days, flag it now and we can start a short approval loop.

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — the kickoff looks good. Quick note from our side: our ML lead (cc’d) ran initial experiments and we’ll need to extend the pilot to 60 days to evaluate latency/quality across our real traffic patterns. Also, the 250k token pack will not be sufficient — provisional ask is +500k tokens for the pilot.

Procurement would prefer a signed SOW but can accept a PO if needed for accounting. The ask is time‑sensitive: our infra team is scheduled to run more load tests starting Oct 20.

Can you outline the internal approvals required to extend the POC and grant the extra tokens/credits? We’re trying not to lose momentum.

Appreciate it,
Amina Rahman
Head of Platform — Halcyon Analytics
amina@halcyon.ai

Team — looping you in. Halcyon asked for a 60‑day pilot and +500k tokens (on top of the standard sandbox). They are on a tight schedule (load tests start Oct 20).

Why I think it’s strategic: Halcyon is evaluating us for a multi‑tenant offering across 3 product lines — landing them as a reference customer unlocks several other mid‑market prospects in our vertical. They’re not asking for custom SLAs, just runway and credits to finish validation.

Ask: can Deal Desk or Execs approve a one‑time extension + credit grant? I propose: 60 days total, 500k tokens additional, and a commitment to an RFP conversation if trials meet benchmarks (we’d capture as a soft‑commit in HubSpot). If approved, I’ll send a short acceptance SOW and loop legal for signature.

Attaching the usage snapshot and draft SOW for context.

—Vanessa

Vanessa — thanks for the context and the crisp ask. I’m comfortable approving a constrained, conditionally‑scoped concession. Proposed executive approval:

- Grant: one‑time 500k token credit (restricted to PLG sandbox environment)
- Duration: extend pilot to 60 days total (from original start)
- Conditions: Halcyon must run the load tests Oct 20–27, provide the two benchmarking prompt sets, and agree to a 30‑minute post‑trial review with our Solutions team.
- Doc: we’ll issue a one‑page Addendum to the standard SOW (no pricing changes). Legal to approve the addendum language.

Markus — please confirm that infra capacity and quota config are straightforward. Chloe — please loop Legal to draft the one‑pager and confirm DocuSign flow. I’ll tag this as an executive‑approved concession in the Deal Desk tracker once Legal signs off.

Hi Amina — good news. Executive concession approved with a few simple conditions. Summary below and next steps: 

What we’re approving now
- One‑time credit: 500,000 tokens applied to your sandbox workspace (restricted to the PLG sandbox environment).
- Pilot duration: extended to 60 days total; sandbox will automatically expire at 23:59 PT on the final day.

Conditions
1) Halcyon commits to run the Oct 20–27 load test window and to share the two benchmarking prompt sets with our Solutions team.
2) Post‑trial: 30‑minute review meeting (we’ll schedule during week of Nov 9) to review results and next steps.
3) Addendum signature: please sign the attached SOW + one‑page addendum in DocuSign by Oct 19 to lock the extension and credits.

Next steps I’ll take
- Finalize the addendum with Legal and send DocuSign (Chloe taking lead).
- Markus will flip the quota and confirm by reply.
- Jonas has recorded this as an approved concession in Deal Desk (deal id DL‑2026‑0937).

If that all looks good, we’ll send the DocuSign now so procurement can complete the signature flow.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the load test.

Best,
